request.jdText:
Toss is hiring a Product Engineer to build delightful, high-traffic financial products used by millions of users every day.

[Responsibilities]
- Own end-to-end delivery of customer-facing features across web and mobile
- Design and implement REST/GraphQL APIs and integrate with internal payment systems
- Collaborate with PMs and designers to ship A/B tested experiments weekly
- Build secure auth flows using OAuth 2.0 and JWT-based session management
- Operate services on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda) and contribute to system design reviews

[Required]
- 2+ years of frontend development with React and TypeScript
- Solid understanding of HTTP, REST, and modern web fundamentals
- Backend experience (Node.js or Go) and ability to design APIs end-to-end
- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and CI/CD pipelines
- Hands-on experience with system design for high-availability services

[Preferred]
- Fintech or payments domain experience
- Contributions to open source, side projects, or technical writing

request.jdText:
Kakao is hiring a Backend Engineer for a new platform team building Node.js / TypeScript microservices that power services used by tens of millions of users.

[Responsibilities]
- Design, build, and operate Node.js services written in TypeScript (NestJS framework)
- Own service-level SLOs, including latency, error budgets, and capacity planning
- Integrate with existing PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis infrastructure on AWS
- Lead code reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and drive technical design discussions

[Required]
- 3+ years of backend engineering experience in production
- Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript runtime internals
- Production experience with NestJS (or equivalent Node.js framework)
- RDBMS modeling and query optimization (PostgreSQL preferred)
- Containerized deployment workflows (Docker, Kubernetes)

[Preferred]
- Prior experience migrating services between languages (Python → Node.js a plus)
- Event-driven architecture with Kafka or similar message brokers
- Experience operating services on AWS at scale

request.jdText:
Meta is hiring Software Engineers across infrastructure, product, and platform teams to build systems serving billions of users worldwide.

[Responsibilities]
- Design and implement large-scale distributed systems used across the company
- Write production code in multiple languages (Hack, Python, C++, Go, TypeScript)
- Participate in System Design Interview-style reviews for new services
- Contribute to open source projects and internal developer platforms
- Collaborate across time zones with global engineering teams; all communication in English

[Required]
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong algorithm and data structure fundamentals (LeetCode-style coding test required at onsite)
- Proven experience with system design for high-traffic, low-latency services
- Resume submitted in English; comfortable conducting interviews in English
- Production experience with at least one of: React, TypeScript, Go, Kubernetes

[Preferred]
- Open source contributions or maintainership of widely-used libraries
- Experience leading multi-team technical initiatives
- Prior work at a global tech company (FAANG-tier preferred)
